title: Maiolica – Adoration of the Shepherds, 5 Euro
descriptionPlain: Description The scene portrayed by Italian majolica artists for centuries returns here in a form full of delicacy. Guided by light, the shepherds bow before the Infant. The motif has been faithfully transferred onto a silver coin with a handcrafted porcelain insert that preserves the colours and character of the Renaissance original. This is the third edition in the Majolica series, combining the artistry of ceramics with the precision of minting craftsmanship.
